opening.argument: The video addresses a concrete technology issue: Netflix playback on an iPhone or iPad, beaming through AirPlay, and an on-screen playback error. The title identifies “Netflix cuts support for beaming your streaming video via AirPlay,” while the supplied frames show the Netflix application and a failed title playback.
